bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs (SMAppService.mainApp), springboard/proto/src/extras.rs, springboard/src/shell/extras.rs, springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (Settings > General > Login Items)
summary: Login items for the app itself are covered: register, unregister, refresh and a four-case status enum, with the shell keeping the list and starting the apps at session start. Error values (kSMError*), unregister(completionHandler:) and openSystemSettingsLoginItems() are built (host-tested). Launch agents, launch daemons, embedded helper executables, the deprecated SMJob/SMLoginItemSetEnabled calls have no BifrOSt counterpart.

features.feature: Login item for the main app (SMAppService.mainApp)
features.note: register and unregister are asynchronous: the result arrives as App::login_item_status with the request id; Apple returns it inline or through a completion handler

features.feature: Refresh and status of the login item
features.note: NotRegistered, Enabled, RequiresApproval and NotFound all exist; RequiresApproval is never produced because there is no approval step

unregister_with(ctx, done) calls done(None) when the shell reports NotRegistered and done(Some(ServiceError)) otherwise; unknown items fail at once with JobNotFound. Tests: unregister_with_completes_when_the_shell_answers (host), unregister_with_reports_a_refused_call_at_once (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Verify on Midget for parity.

service_bundle.rs finds an embedded helper by its bundle identifier and gives the reference's JobNotFound and NotFound answers; the handle does not read the app bundle yet, so it still answers NotFound. Tests: a_login_item_identifier_finds_its_embedded_helper, a_helper_reports_enabled_only_when_the_user_switched_it_on (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not yet tested on the VM or Midget

service_bundle.rs finds Contents/Library/LaunchAgents/<name>.plist in an app bundle's file list and gives InvalidPlist or JobPlistNotFound. No launch agent is loaded or started: bifrostd is the system supervisor and is not exposed to apps. Tests: a_job_plist_is_found_only_in_its_own_directory, a_job_plist_name_is_checked_before_the_bundle_is_searched (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not yet tested on the VM or Midget

service_bundle.rs finds Contents/Library/LaunchDaemons/<name>.plist in an app bundle's file list. No daemon is installed: there is no SDK API for root daemons shipped in an app bundle. Tests: a_job_plist_is_found_only_in_its_own_directory, a_valid_job_name_is_not_found_because_no_job_ships (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not yet tested on the VM or Midget

features.apple: helper executables inside the app's main bundle, registered through SMAppService
features.note: the SDK doc states BifrOSt has no embedded login-item helpers, launch agents or daemons

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (Login Items page, LoginItemRemove action); springboard/src/shell/extras.rs (login.items pref); wired: springboard/src/shell/login_items_page.rs (order_group); springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (Login Items page); springboard/src/shell/extras.rs (Registry::move_earlier, login.items pref); springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs (open_system_settings_login_items); springboard/proto/src/extras.rs (LoginOp::OpenSettings)
features.note: the page exists, lets the user remove items, and apps open it with open_system_settings_login_items (LoginOp::OpenSettings, handled in shell/extras.rs and the login-items service). Host unit tests only; verify on Midget for parity.

status_for_legacy_plist gives Enabled, NotRegistered or NotFound for absolute plist paths the shell lists; BifrOSt has no earlier login-item plist format, so nothing calls it yet. Tests: legacy_plist_status_follows_the_shell_list, legacy_plist_paths_must_be_absolute_plist_paths_without_parent_steps (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not yet tested on the VM or Midget

features.apple: kSMErrorAlreadyRegistered, kSMErrorJobNotFound, kSMErrorLaunchDeniedByUser and the other kSMError values, SMAppServiceErrorDomain
features.note: ServiceError carries the kSMError* values 1 to 11 in SMAppServiceErrorDomain with the reference texts; AlreadyRegistered, JobNotFound, LaunchDeniedByUser and InvalidPlist are produced by register/unregister, and the login-items service reply carries error and code. Tests: error_values_follow_the_reference_numbering, error_values_carry_the_service_error_domain, a_refused_register_reply_maps_to_its_error_value (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 24 tests. Wave 4 (theme-20, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. deprecated by Apple; a desktop equivalent would sit on the bifrostd and app policy layers (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs), none exposed to apps

features.apple: SMJobSubmit, SMJobRemove, SMJobCopyDictionary, SMCopyAllJobDictionaries and the kSMDomain constants
features.note: deprecated launchd C API tied to Apple's launchd; BifrOSt's supervisor is bifrostd with no app-facing job API

set_login_item_enabled fails with JobNotFound and sends nothing, because no helper ships; apps use SMAppService. Test: the_deprecated_enable_call_is_refused_without_a_request (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not yet tested on Midget

gaps: Launch agents and launch daemons: SMAppService.agent(plistName:) and daemon(plistName:) (the SDK doc states none exist)
Embedded helper executables registered from the app bundle, including loginItem(identifier:)
Deprecated SMJobBless, SMLoginItemSetEnabled and the SMJob* launchd functions have no counterpart
